must_fix.issue: Headings and intro read as unfinished: 'Villa Pliniana, Como branch (town to confirm)', 'Villa Làrio, Como branch (town to confirm)', 'whose town we are confirming', and 'Como branch; town to confirm' in the table. Readers took it as proof nobody has been there.
must_fix.fix: Remove the phrase 'town to confirm' and 'whose town we are confirming' everywhere. Keep the shore grouping as 'Como branch' (heading: '### Villa Pliniana, Como branch'; table Where cell: 'Como branch'). Rewrite the list intro to 'western shore first, then two villas on the Como branch, then Bellagio and the eastern shore'. Put the unknown town into that villa's single VERIFY note, e.g. [[VERIFY: town for Villa Pliniana from official source]] and [[VERIFY: town for Villa Làrio from official source]]. Do not guess the towns.

must_fix.issue: Unconfirmed towns for Villa Pliniana and Villa Làrio.
must_fix.fix: Confirm each town from the official operator/venue source and add it to 03-source-pack.json. Until then the writer's single per-villa [[VERIFY]] stands.

must_fix.issue: Walls of 'Not published' / 'Not stated' bullets under every villa: tiring on a phone and reads as desk research rather than expertise.
must_fix.fix: Per villa, merge every unpublished field into one line, e.g. '- **Not published:** event capacity, minimum nights, curfew, wet-weather plan. Your Wedded Advisor asks the villa and confirms these in writing.' Keep every sourced bullet and its fact marker as is. Keep the honesty (do not imply the fields are known).

must_fix.issue: Nine-column comparison table is unreadable on phone and iPad, and most cells say 'Confirm'.
must_fix.fix: Cut the table to five columns: Villa | Area | Sleeps on site | Seats (dinner) | Civil ceremony on site. Use 'Como branch' for Pliniana and Làrio. Keep fact markers on sourced cells; use 'Ask' rather than 'Confirm' for unknowns. Min nights, curfew, dock and wet weather stay in the villa cards (one-line format above). Add one sentence under the table: 'Minimum nights, curfew and rain plans are rarely published; we list what each villa states in its entry above.'

must_fix.issue: No cost anchor at all. Primary reader cannot tell if a villa weekend is 30k or 150k before involving parents; 03-source-pack budget_range_aud is empty.
must_fix.fix: Do not invent a figure. Business (Nic) to supply a 'From AUD' exclusive-use range if one can be signed off: [[VERIFY: business to supply 'From AUD' exclusive-use villa range for a weekend, Nic sign-off]]. Writer meanwhile: keep 'None of the eight villas publishes an exclusive-use fee', add the cost-guide link to Key takeaways as well as the cost section, and add 'Your Wedded Advisor confirms the exclusive-use fee for your dates, in AUD and in writing, before you commit.'

must_fix.issue: Wedded Concierge fee model and whether Wedded Wonderland takes commissions or mark-ups from villas, caterers or hotels is not stated; 'first idea to the last dance' sits where the reader wanted the fee model.
must_fix.fix: Business to supply how the fee is set and the commission policy: [[VERIFY: business to supply Wedded Concierge fee model (flat/percentage) and whether commissions or mark-ups are taken]]. Writer: near the closing CTA keep 'agree their fee in writing before any work begins' and add 'Your Wedded Advisor explains how the fee is worked out, in writing, before any work begins.' Replace 'from first idea to the last dance' with a plain line. No claim about commissions until the business supplies it.

must_fix.issue: Wedded Privileges is unexplained; sceptic reads it as a hidden commission, funding parent cannot tell what it is. The /privileges page is a 404 so it cannot be linked as the explanation.
must_fix.fix: Business to define it: [[VERIFY: business to supply a one-line definition of Wedded Privileges and who funds it; /privileges returns 404]]. Writer: do not link /privileges; until defined, rephrase to 'Your Wedded Advisor explains in writing what Wedded Privileges includes for your guests' rooms.' Do not describe the perk.

must_fix.issue: Deposits, refund and cancellation terms, contract language and currency, and who is responsible (Wedded Wonderland or the villa) are absent; this is the funding parent's main money worry.
must_fix.fix: No terms may be stated without business input: [[VERIFY: business to supply deposit, refund and contract terms and what Wedded Wonderland is accountable for versus the villa]]. Writer: in the cost section add a short 'Questions to ask before paying a deposit' list (deposit amount and due date, refund and cancellation terms, contract language, currency of payment, who holds the contract) and the line 'Your Wedded Advisor confirms these terms in writing before you pay anything.' Questions only, no answers.

must_fix.issue: Accountability and a human: no named Advisor, no phone option, unclear who is on the ground or who to call on the weekend.
must_fix.fix: Business to supply whether a named Advisor and a phone/call booking option can be shown, and on-the-day contact arrangements: [[VERIFY: business to supply named Wedded Advisor, phone or call-booking option, and on-the-day contact]]. cro-specialist to add a 'book a call' option only if the business confirms one exists. Writer adds nothing invented.

must_fix.issue: No proof of delivery: no real wedding at any of the eight villas; 03-source-pack real_weddings is empty.
must_fix.fix: Business to supply a real Wedded Wonderland wedding at one of these villas (venue, date, consented details): [[VERIFY: business to supply a real wedding at one of the eight villas, with consent]]. Until supplied, no 'see a real wedding' link or claim.

should_fix.issue: Accessibility for older guests is missing: steps, ramps, boat boarding, car access from drop-off to terrace.
should_fix.fix: Add a short note in 'Getting to the villa' phrased as questions to ask each villa: How many steps from drop-off or dock to the ceremony, dinner terrace and a ground-floor bedroom? Are there ramps or a lift? Can guests board the boat from level ground? Can older guests come by road instead of by boat? No villa-specific accessibility claims.

should_fix.issue: No airport-to-villa transfer times (only Balbiano's '40 minutes from central Milan', which is not an airport).
should_fix.fix: Source transfer times from Malpensa, Linate and Bergamo to each area from an official source, or keep [[VERIFY: airport to villa transfer times]]. Writer should note '40 minutes' is from central Milan, not the airport.

should_fix.issue: Where guests stay is generic: which towns and hotels suit each villa, and late-night returns for older guests.
should_fix.fix: Source nearest hotel towns per area, or keep the existing [[VERIFY: nearest hotel towns and transfer times for each villa]]. No hotel names without a source.

should_fix.issue: Primary reader wants evidence the team knows these villas beyond published pages (insider detail per villa).
should_fix.fix: Add sourced insider details where 03-source-pack has them; do not invent. Otherwise leave as is.

consider.issue: Not clear whether the service is only for Australians or quotes only in AUD.
consider.fix: Add one short sentence (Key takeaways or close): this guide is written for Australian couples, but Wedded Concierge works with couples anywhere. Do not promise other currencies.

consider.issue: Scale: no word on guest lists larger than any single villa.
consider.fix: At most one sentence in 'Where guests stay': larger guest lists usually need a hotel or several properties alongside the villa, and your Wedded Advisor can look at that for you. No claims about past large weddings.

consider.issue: Discretion, security, NDAs, private aviation, private enquiry route.

consider.fix: Check whether additional official facts exist; if not, keep entries short and honest.

consider.issue: Room-block and 'perks per room' wording feels like group travel to a high-end reader.
consider.fix: Keep for the primary reader; see conflicts. Plain wording only.

consider.issue: Travel insurance, medical care nearby for older relatives.

conflicts_resolved: Cost figure: uhnw praised printing no price; planner_couple (primary), sceptic and search_visitor want a range. Resolved for the primary reader: add a 'From AUD' range only if the business supplies one with Nic's sign-off; otherwise a VERIFY marker plus the cost-guide link in Key takeaways. Never an invented figure.

Room blocks and Wedded Privileges: uhnw wants them cut as package language; planner_couple and funding_parent need guests housed and the perk explained. The brief's reader has 60 to 120 guests flying from Australia, so the room-block section stays; Privileges gets a business-supplied definition instead of being cut.
Process reassurance (AUD, fee in writing): uhnw reads it as over-explaining; planner_couple, funding_parent and sceptic called it the most reassuring line. Kept for the primary reader.

'Not published' honesty: sceptic values it; planner_couple, search_visitor, funding_parent and uhnw find the repetition draining. Resolved by consolidating to one line per villa, keeping the honesty without the walls.

Comparison table: planner_couple wants it to share with parents; mobile readers cannot use nine columns. Resolved with a five-column table (villa, area, sleeps on site, seats, civil on site), with remaining fields kept in the villa cards.

Guest scale: uhnw (200 to 400 guests, private aviation, security) is outside the brief's reader (60 to 120 guests). At most one sentence about larger guest lists needing a hotel or several properties; no discretion or security copy.
payload.gate_reason: Weighted enquiry likelihood 2.70 is below 3.8 and there are 10 must_fix items. Not 'stop': relevance to the primary persona is 5 and trust is 4 across four of five personas; the piece meets the brief.
